title: mentha arvensis var. borealis
intro: Mentha arvensis var. borealis, commonly known as wild bergamot mint, is a variety of mint plant native to North America. It is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving digestive issues, and acting as an antiseptic to prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of wild bergamot mint include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it effective in treating headaches, muscle pain, and menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and beta-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
